prompt: igitz: Igitz were a species of small amphibians hailing from the planet Naboo. Those blue-skinned, omnivorous critters dwelled in the planet's many dense swamps. The igitz were a popular pet in most Gungan civilizations and this lead to the species becoming present on other worlds. The igitz sits upright on thick bent hind legs, with a round squat body and short forelimbs that end in a few clawed toes. Draw one small spike at the back of the brow and one near the nose, and a short finned tail at the rear that shows on east and north. The body sits upright on thick folded haunches, with visibly shorter forelimbs ending in a few clawed toes beneath the chest. A single longitudinal dorsal frill follows the spine in all facings, appearing edge-on above the head in south and broadside along the back in east. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background.

prompt: mastiff phalone: A large, long-bodied four-legged avian predator of the Maridun savannas, built like a griffin: a coat of grey feathers barred with dark blue, a mane of dark feathers over neck and shoulders, and a long feathered tail. They will break off from prey that fights back too hard, only to return and strike again later, and an agitated one is said to be as dangerous as a rancor and just as hard to bring down.
